name: PodText
tagline: PodText is the fastest way to transcribe podcasts and audio/video content into accurate, editable text
description: PodText is the fastest way to transcribe podcasts and audio/video content into accurate, editable text. Paste a link from Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or Ximalaya — or upload an MP3/MP4 — and get a full transcript with a synced audio player, click-to-jump navigation, and powerful full-text search.
